name: ChatGPT Images 2.5
summary: Generate and edit images with much better likeness for people and pets, up to 50% faster. Rolling out to every ChatGPT tier plus Codex, with a @Sketch tool for drawing references and two new API models, Flare and Sunburst.

name: Project HydraFusion
summary: Cut coding-agent costs by letting Copilot CLI pick and combine models per task — 67% cheaper than Claude Opus 5 on Terminal-Bench 2.1, with a slightly higher pass rate. Free research preview on every Copilot plan, behind /experimental.

name: GPT-6 Astra
summary: Swap in a new flagship for hard reasoning and long agent runs — live as gpt-6-astra in the API and rolling out to ChatGPT Plus and Pro. Costs $10 per million input tokens, $50 per million output.

name: K2 Horizon
summary: Run a capable open model locally at 0.9B, 3.7B, or 7B, or self-host up to 375B. Apache 2.0 with weights, training data, and code published, plus day-zero Ollama, vLLM, and GGUF support.

name: Hermes Desktop
summary: Set up a local model in one click — the app reads your RAM, VRAM, and GPU, picks a model that fits, and starts a llama.cpp server. MIT-licensed and free on Mac, Windows, and Linux.

name: Muse Spark 1.3
summary: Point an agent at long multi-file coding jobs at $1.25 per million input tokens with a 1M-token context, live now in Muse Code and the Meta Model API. It uses about 20% fewer tool calls and 25% fewer tokens than 1.2.

name: Background Computer Use
summary: Hand off clicking and typing while you keep working — Claude drives apps in the background on Mac and Windows without grabbing your mouse. In beta for Pro and Max subscribers in Cowork and Claude Code.

name: Gemini 3.8 Flash
summary: Point a coding agent at a much better workhorse for the same $0.75 per million input tokens as 3.7 Flash. Terminal-Bench jumps from 81.6% to 90.8%. Available now in AI Studio and the Gemini API.
